newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman downgrades three gold stocks.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman downgrades three gold stocks.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers analyst Daniel McConvey said he cut his 1997 gold price forecast to $350 from $390 and downgraded his stock purchase ratings on three mining stocks.

-- In published comments, the analyst said he lowered both Homestake Mining Co and Santa Fe Pacific Gold Corp to neutral from outperform and cut Freeport-McMoRan Copper & Gold Inc to outperform from buy.

-- McConvey said he expected more central bank gold sales and an increase in producer hedging. He predicted that these actions will contribute to a small supply surplus over the next three years. He noted that gold forward sale premium rates are upt to about 4 percent.

-- He said that despite the recent fall in gold equity prices, stock values are, according to Lehman's valuation ratio, which factors in current gold prices, slightly higher than average relative to gold prices.
